# Nidhi Matele

> Freelance software developer building websites, cross-platform iOS and Android
> apps in Flutter, AI crawl optimization, and published books. Former software engineer at a multinational engineering company in India,
> with 4 years professional experience. 10+ live projects

## Services

- **Website development** — Custom, fast, mobile-friendly websites: landing pages,
  business sites and content hubs. Built SEO-ready and AI-ready from day one.
- **Mobile app development** — iOS and Android apps built in Flutter from a single
  codebase. Includes UI/UX design, testing on real devices, and App Store and
  Google Play submission.
- **AI crawl optimization (GEO / LLMO)** — Structuring websites so AI assistants
  such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity can crawl, understand and cite the
  business: schema markup, structured data, machine-readable semantic content,
  llms.txt, sitemaps and crawler access rules.
- **Books and study material** — Written and designed educational content, study
  guides, math workbooks, activity books and printables, published through Amazon
  KDP. Includes the Quick Math Tricks mental-math workbook series for children.

Pricing is quoted per project after a scoping conversation; clients receive a fixed
price and timeline before work begins.

## Background

- 4 years as a software developer at a multinational engineering company in India.
- Relocated to the USA; self-taught WordPress, then Android Studio, then Xcode and
  Swift, then consolidated onto Flutter for single-codebase cross-platform delivery.
- Delivers projects solo, end to end: design, development, launch and handover.
- 5 years as a parent coach and STEM volunteer in US schools — Science Olympiad
  coach, science fair mentor, robotics and coding coach, room parent.
- Co-filed a patent application (pending) with her daughter.

## Live projects

- **IntelliEats** — iOS and Android app (Flutter). Scans food labels and identifies
  unhealthy ingredients, with premium dietary detection for vegetarian, vegan,
  nut-free, gluten-free, lactose and keto. Rated 5.0 on the App Store. Free.
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/intellieats/id6744873855
  - Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Lakh.intelli_eats
  - Website: https://intelieats.com/
  - Origin: began as her daughter's science fair project, which won Grand Prize at
    the Science & Engineering Fair of Metro Detroit and State Merit at the 3M Young
    Scientist Challenge. Nidhi refined the research and developed the shipped app.
- **Learn the Basics** — https://www.learnthebasics.org/ — Kid-friendly website
  teaching AI, machine learning, neural networks and LLMs, with paid printable
  study material.
- **BeVegToday** — https://bevegtoday.com/ — Vegetarian recipe platform.
- **YupNri** — https://yupnri.com/ — Companion platform for Non-Resident Indians:
  live exchange rates, news, calculators and community.
- **Books on Amazon** (written, designed and self-published — 5 titles):
  - Continuous Addition Tricks — Quick Math Tricks series, Book 1. Mental-math
    workbook for ages 6+: 7 addition shortcuts, 70 practice problems, 2 practice
    tests, full answer keys. Prep for Math Olympiad, AMC and CML. Co-authored with
    Lakhith Matele. https://a.co/d/07Dznky8
  - Division Tricks — Quick Math Tricks series, Book 2. Mental-math workbook for
    ages 8+: 18 divisibility and fast-division tricks (rules for 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8,
    9, 11, 12, 14), 180 practice problems, 2 practice tests, full answer keys. Prep
    for Math Kangaroo, Math Olympiad, AMC and CML. Co-authored with Lakhith Matele.
    https://a.co/d/0a5L3186
  - Rainbow Village Friends — Coloring & Activity Book: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H35K79YN
  - Epic Travel Adventure Journal for Kids: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H236ZRKG
  - Travel Time — Kids Vacation Journal: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H1HQ2VT9
- Two further mobile apps currently in development.
